raw_response:
The raw_customers table is an SCD2-style dimension: 30 customers have two rows, one current and one historical. The silver_customers step keeps both, so the join fans out and inflates counts.

The numbers fit this. silver has 4699 POSTED transactions, and the gold join gives 5415. The extra 716 rows come from transactions of the 30 duplicated customers being counted twice.

The fix is to keep only the is_current = True rows in silver_customers. Each of the 200 customers has exactly one current row (True=200, distinct=200). The signup_date is the same across copies, and valid_from is 2025-01-01 for current rows and 2023-06-01 for historical ones.

One open question is whether to use the region as of each transaction date. The transactions run 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-18, and the current rows are valid from 2025-01-01, which is before every transaction. The historical rows have valid_from 2023-06-01 and appear to have been superseded on 2025-01-01. So the current row applies to all transactions, and filtering on is_current is correct.

The fix keeps the columns unchanged: customer_id and region.
